title: CW-GEO-1 Reversible Baseline Codec
negative_results: a corrupted vector is refused by decode() (Geo1Error) and yields an INVALID CodecResult

claims.statement: CW-GEO-1 round-trips every case in docs/cwatlas/fixtures/synthetic_round_trip_cases.json to within its declared quantization (1e-8 deg lat/lon, 1e-4 m height), and encode(decode(vector)) is byte-for-byte identical (POWER).
CW-GEO-1 encodes only a declared canonical coordinate and is independent of any source-vector semantics; every vector is versioned and checksummed.
That the codec is reversible is no evidence about what any operator-reported source vector meant.

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic fixtures only, no private inputs
